entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Baronian born as Joseph Lous Baronian also known as Alexandre Lous is a French-language Belgian writer of Armenian descent. He was born in Antwerp, Belgium. Baronian is a critic, essayist, children's book writer and novelist.
